horses.spotlight_comment: March foal; 30,000gns foal, 4,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Bill Silvers (7f; RPR 99) and Gaelic Approach (1m4f; 77); dam placed 1m-1m4f (78), half-sister to 1m4f winners Empyrea and La Joya; could be one for later on and he's probably best watched on debut.

32,000euros foal, £24,000 yearling; first foal; dam unraced sister to winners Rhythmic Intent (useful 1m2f-14.5f) and Fortune Triple (HK 1m1f/1m3f), is granddaughter of French Oaks winner Caerlina; has plenty of stamina on dam's side and he could be a longer-term prospect.

35,000euros foal, £44,000 yearling; Kodiac filly who is closely related to 7f AW 2yo winner Dynamite Katie (RPR 78); dam unraced half-sister to French 1m4f Listed winner Balaythous and useful 7f-1m1f winner Saphirside; yard 2-3 with 2yos this season and she needs a close look on debut.
Big market drifter at Wolverhampton (AW; 11-1) two weeks ago and he finished into a remote sixth of seven; should be more streetwise this time but he needs a transformation on his second start.

January foal; £55,000 yearling; didn't live up to market expectations when seventh on Newbury debut (good; 7-2) last week but he ran green after a slow start; should know much more this time and it wouldn't be a surprise if he took a major step forward.

February foal; Land Force half-brother to winners Tribal Craft (1m2f-1m6f including Group 3; RPR 110), Seattle King (7f 2yo/1m2f; 90), Star Maker (11.6f Flat, 81; 2m-2m3f hurdle) and Dream Seeker (German 6.5f); dam 1m/1m2f winner (93); yard has had a 2yo winner this season and had a 20% record with juveniles last term.

10,000gns February foal; well backed into 3-1 at Wolverhampton (AW) two weeks ago but he never got involved before finishing a well-held fourth of seven; should benefit from that experience but he needs plenty of progress on this switch to turf.

Ardad colt; third foal; dam 9.4f/1m2f winner (including 2yo; RPR 87), half-sister to 1m Listed winner Staying On, out of maiden half-sister to Rockfel winner Yawl, family of Oaks winner Talent; has speed and stamina in pedigree and interesting to see how he figures in market.
1,000gns yearling; 16-1 at Bath (good) three weeks ago and she dropped out before before finishing a remote eighth of ten.

February foal; 15,000gns foal, 42,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to 6f AW winner Black Cab (RPR 56); dam 6f winner (86), sister to 5f/6f Group 3 winner Swiss Diva, half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Swiss Spirit, out of 5f Listed winner; has lots of speed in pedigree and she's an interesting newcomer for yard that that won this race last year.

March foal; 7,000euros foal, 15,000euros yearling; first foal of a 7f 2yo winner (RPR 97), out of French 10.5f winning half-sister to 1m1f Flat and 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Authentic Act; others look more likely and he's best watched unless market suggests otherwise.

Ran green and hung left from halfway but he was only just run out of third on his debut at Thirsk (good) two weeks ago; that was an encouraging start behind a useful prospect and he's a key player if he can build on that.

Ended last season with a game win in Group 3 at Ascot (6f, soft) in October; repeatedly met trouble when only seventh in Saudi Arabia (a race he'd won two years earlier) in February and things didn't really go his way again in a Listed race at Doncaster last month; has possibilities on this drop back in class and his last handicap win was off 1lb higher.

Completed an AW hat-trick when scoring on his handicap debut at Newcastle (6f) last April; held in six subsequent runs but he went close off this mark at Southwell in November and was a creditable third at Newcastle three weeks ago; now returns to turf but he ran well in a fast-ground Listed event last spring and he's still unexposed in this sphere; in the mix.

Won on stable debut at Southwell (6f, Tapeta) in November and he's posted some solid efforts since then; hard to rule out another good run but this is a step back up in grade and sole turf win was 19 months ago.

C&D winner who ended his 2025 campaign with a success and creditable effort over 5f at Newcastle (AW); was as good as ever in those two runs but he was well below form on his reappearance at Pontefract (5f, good to soft) 18 days ago; may have needed that run but he needs more progress to defy this mark.

Dual turf winner who made it 2-2 on AW when completing a double at Newcastle (6f; off 4lb lower) last month; didn't fire in his hat-trick bid at Kempton but he still has potential and is not ruled out in suitable conditions back on turf.

Four-time AW winner who has finished close up on Tapeta (5f/6f) in his last three runs; record of 1-26 on turf but he's on a lower mark in this sphere and he ran well in the Great St Wilfrid at Ripon (6f, good to firm) last summer; dangerous.

Listed winner (5f/6f) for his previous yards and he's run respectably in two 5f handicaps for his new trainer this spring; needs to find some extra spark but he's edging down the weights and this step back up in trip looks a good move.

Won four times during a progressive campaign last year but he's come up short in Listed/Group 3 events this spring; seems ideally suited by fast ground but he's still 4lb higher than for his last win and has some work to do back in a handicap.

Well handicapped on his best form last season but he's not easy to predict and has been up and down during another spell in Bahrain since December; comes with risks attached back in Britain and most of his wins have been at Chester; tongue-tie worn last time is removed.

Two 5f wins for Roger Varian but latest was in June 2023 and he was quiet last season; returns for new yard after wind surgery but he has a mixed record when fresh and this is highly competitive; down the list.

On lengthy losing but he's a smart handicapper on his day and he returned from five months off with a good third at Newcastle (6f, AW) two weeks ago; should benefit from that run and he remains well treated on his second in the Stewards' Cup last August; interesting contender.

Record of 5-10 for Harry Charlton and his last win was in a conditions event at Kempton (6f, AW) in October; ran without his declared tongue-tie when fourth on stable debut at Southwell in January but he finished down the field in another Class 2 handicap at Newcastle two weeks later; conditions should be fine on this return to turf but he needs to step up again after another break.

Ran creditably at Lingfield in January when bidding for a 6f AW double; 8lb higher than when second at Newmarket (7f) on last turf attempt but he's proved consistent since being gelded and his first two handicap wins were on good to firm; in the mix.

Had ups and downs since showing decent form earlier in career and was well treated when starting out for this trainer in 2025, winning three of his last four 6f starts on AW and turf; went down only narrowly back on turf (good to firm; headgear left off) in UAE during March and he's of interest now back with former yard.

Said goodbye to 2025 with a Newmarket win (6f, good to soft) in November; has won on good to firm but he missed a recent intended return on the surface and this might be needed anyway (soundly beaten here last April).

horses.spotlight_comment: Has a better strike-rate on AW than turf but he's capable of useful 6f form on grass and made short work of his rivals at Bath (extended 5f, good) last week; now 6lb higher but this mark isn't beyond him on past exploits; would have welcomed rain but still considered.

Can lead; smart 2yo who began 3yo season on a mark of 102; has shown just humdrum form in three turf handicaps, despite a sliding mark, and was way back behind Justcallmepete at Bath last week; has it to prove now.

Weighted to go well on best turf form and the drying ground shouldn't cause her any grief, having run so well on good to firm at York (6f) last June; also a winner of her one C&D start, in 2023, and the booking of Billy Loughnane signals intent; has prospects despite lacking a recent run.

Should be all the better for her Doncaster reappearance and she's back on the same mark as for her Windsor success (6f, good to firm) last June; however, all her turf wins have come there and at Salisbury and this is the first time she's run on this track.

Winner of both C&D starts, in October (good to soft) and when pulling well clear (good) 12 days ago; has won on good to firm so the warm weather shouldn't be a problem but the new 9lb higher mark might be.
Two AW wins in January, over 6f and 7f; just averagely handicapped now and it's a long time since he's run well on turf but he wouldn't be out of it on past form on grass.

Well held on AW in November but progressive on turf for new yard previously, following a close second at Yarmouth (6f, good) with wins there (good to soft) and at Bath (extended 5f, heavy); may well do better on good to firm as her dam's best form for this yard came on the same going.

Not yet off the mark but she's had two close calls on the AW this year, notably when only just failing to get up at Wolverhampton (6f) in February, against one on the fifth leg of a seven-timer; acts on turf, too, and may well figure back from short break.

Lightly raced maiden for two yards but he didn't get the best of runs after a slow start at Bath (first 5f run; good) and may well be ready to play more of a part now back at 6f following a further 3lb drop.
Well beaten in two turf handicaps either side of a break in 2025 but he was off the mark on the AW in March and has run respectably in defeat since; might well have more to offer on this surface.

Won 2yo AW maiden; his 3yo season never really got going but he was on a much-reduced mark when runner-up on two occasions (7f) in March; well held on yard debut since, though, and likely best watched back on turf.

Sole turf win came over 1m2f in 2023 and three subsequent successes have been on the AW (1m and 7f); has continued to run well since the latest of them in February but this is his first 6f run since his debut.

Three wins in 2024, at 7f and 5f; mostly rather underpowered in 2025 and no obvious sign fitting headgear was a help in the autumn, but he's 10lb lower than on reappearance last April so there is handicapping hope.

Five turf wins at 6f-7f, the latest two over the latter trip on this track; he's had some excuses for low-key reappearances in the past but it's still a stretch to expect him to be on song for this one.

Both turf wins on Brighton's sharp track but she made up plenty of ground when a never-nearer third in this race (good) last year and it wouldn't surprise to see her return to form after a low-key Southwell run last time, having gone close there on her reappearance the time before.

0-31 on turf but he acted perfectly well on the surface in Ireland; first two AW wins for this yard came over 7f but he wasn't bothered by the return to 6f when winning at Wolverhampton 19 days ago; this stiff 6f should suit fine; solid chance.

875,000gns yearling; first foal; dam Listed-placed 1m/8.5f winner (RPR 98), half-sister to winners Bite Of The Cherry (useful 1m5f), Pietra Dura (7f 2yo) and Ever Rigg (1m4f; dam of 1m2f-1m4f Group 1 winner Postponed), out of Moyglare Stud/Lowther winner; interesting newcomer and he holds Derby entry.
20-1 on Chelmsford debut (1m) in November and he was always in rear; been gelded since and can only be watched on his return.

Brother to 1m/8.5f winner Rowayeh (RPR 94), closely related to 8.6f AW 2yo/1m2f turf Listed winner Falakeyah (106); held in third when odds-on at Wolverhampton (8.6f) in November but he finished well behind two rivals who were ridden more prominently; sets a good standard on that promising effort and he's open to progress upped in trip.

Cost 1,500,000gns as a yearling but he's already been gelded and was a remote third with cheekpieces applied on Southwell debut (1m3f, Tapeta) two weeks ago; that was behind a smart prospect but he has quite a bit to find here and others are preferred.

1,100,000gns yearling; never involved when 3-1 at Newmarket (1m, good) in October but he made some good late headway to finish fourth of seven; that was a promising start and he needs a close look upped in trip on his return.

Fifth foal; brother to 7f-1m2f winner Al Mubhir (including Listed; RPR 115), half-brother to three winners including Yabher (1m-1m4f; 96); dam 7f-1m1f winner (including Group 3; 112); has good standard to aim at on debut but he needs checking in market.

Dual AW winner (1m) but he's 0-10 on turf; on reduced mark and was fair third at Wolverhampton (9.4f) last month but he's struggled in his last five turf runs and has something to prove back in this sphere.

Hurdle winner who has finished close up in handicaps at Sedgefield (2m1f, good) in her last two starts; 0-8 on the Flat but she ran respectably in big field at Doncaster (1m2f) last month and is not ruled out back in this sphere.
Big prices and he finished in rear in three novice events (6f/7f) towards the end of last year; now goes handicapping after a break but he needs a transformation on this step up to 1m2f.

5yo who turned things around with a rallying win on his Nottingham reappearance (8.3f, good; 13-2) last Saturday; back up 4lb in the weights but he remains well treated on best form and his penultimate win was over this trip; key player.

On reduced mark and he returned from a break with a good second behind an improver at Bath (1m, good) three weeks ago; has claims if he can back that up but he's still a maiden 16 starts and has stamina to prove at this new trip.

Off the mark at the sixth attempt when landing a Chelmsford handicap (1m2f, AW) last month; justified support with that convincing win but he was only fifth of ten in his follow-up bid at Wolverhampton (9.4f); has bit to prove again after that and he's struggled in two previous runs on turf.
Back to form with a near-miss at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in January but he's taken backward steps in two runs since; overall record is now 1-37 and others are preferred.

Won a Kempton maiden (7f, AW) last spring but she's struggled in handicaps since and was beaten 7l back at Kempton two weeks ago; continues to drop down the weights but she has plenty to prove back up in trip.

McPherson Rob Hornby 9-1 60 - 69 Bumper winner and a fair maiden hurdler; 0-6 on the Flat but he was a good third in a Chelmsford handicap (1m6f) in February and the drop to back to 8.6f looked against him at Wolverhampton last time; should get a good tow into this race and he could be dangerous back up in trip.
Well held in sole start for Andre Fabre in France and same outcome in two runs for new yard this spring; still early days and now goes handicapping but he needs improvement at this new trip.

Won a small-field handicap at Yarmouth (11.5f) last August but has mixed record since and was tailed off at Wolverhampton (1m6f) 19 days ago; may have had stamina issues last time but he's now 1-13 and others are more convincing.
Struggled at big prices in her four Flat runs and same story in two maiden hurdles this year; this is only her second handicap but she needs major improvement back on the Flat.

Dual turf winner who has form figures of 133221363 on AW since Boxing Day and his last win was over 1m2f; still looks feasibly treated on his best form and he's in the mix back on turf (acts on good ground but he's untried on quicker).

Ex-Kevin Philippart de Foy; formerly a useful performer and was successful at Nottingham (8.3f, good to firm) last April; now 24lb lower than for that win but she's struggled since and has form figures of 9050876 for her current yard; opposable.

Well held in three qualifying runs (6f) for Eve Johnson Houghton last season; 4-1 favourite on handicap/stable debut over C&D (good) 12 days ago but he was always in rear and finished 15th of 17; has good pedigree and is still early days but he needs to leave that latest form a long way behind.

Well held in his first two juvenile runs but he showed clear promise when runner-up in a Lingfield novice (1m, AW) in December; drops back in trip after a break but he pulled hard last time and is open to more progress on this handicap debut; interesting contender with Rossa Ryan booked.

No progress in three qualifying runs but he found improvement upped to 7f on nursery debut when a strong-finishing second at Yarmouth (good to soft) in September; only 1lb higher than for that close call and he's an interesting contender with cheekpieces added on his return.

Nine-race maiden who has gone the wrong in handicaps and was always in rear on Newmarket reappearance (7f, good; hood added) 11 days ago; mark continues to fall but she needs a big turnaround on this drop back in grade.

Third of nine on his debut at Brighton (6f, good) last May but went backwards from that in two subsequent runs last season; still unexposed and now goes handicapping at this new trip but he needs to raise his game after six months off.

Close third of four on debut at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last August; didn't match that in two runs during the winter but he's been gelded since and is a possible improver now returned to turf on his handicap debut; needs close look for in-form yard.

Won novice/maiden events at Wolverhampton (7f) for Clive Cox on his first two runs; finished in rear in three handicaps for his current yard but he ran into plenty of trouble over 6f at Southwell 18 days ago; now makes his turf debut but he's on a reduced mark and is not ruled back up in trip.

Beaten a nose on handicap debut at Newcastle (7f), after which he was gelded; won on Tapeta and Polytrack in next two starts and was a creditable second in his hat-trick bid at Kempton (7f) three weeks ago; still lightly raced and he's a big player if he can transfer his progress back on turf.
Seven-race maiden but she returned after a break with a close third in a Lingfield handicap (7f, AW) last month; should benefit from that run and she's respected off only 1lb higher back on turf.

Down the field in three runs for Richard Hannon last summer and was tenth of 12 on his recent handicap/stable debut at Southwell (6f, Tapeta; 11-1); still early days but he needs a transformation at this new trip.

Insole Harry Vigors (7) 14-1 67 66 76 Made a promising start when third at Lingfield (7f, good) last August but she's been well held in three subsequent runs including on handicap/stable debut at Nottingham (8.3f, good) two weeks ago; should be sharper with that run under her belt but she needs improvement back in trip; cheekpieces added.

0-6 but he's reached the frame in two handicaps for his current yard and was beaten less than 2l at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month; hasn't looked entirely straightforward but he didn't get the best of runs last time and he's in the mix back on turf; hood reapplied
